**Pathway:** {{< meta pathway >}}\
**Prerequisite:** CS05\
**Previous:** [SQ01 Teardown](sq01-teardown.qmd)\
**Next:** [SQ03 Storage and expansion](sq03-storage-expansion.qmd)

The teacher prepares every fault and records the known baseline. Possible stations include improperly seated RAM, disconnected storage, wrong boot order, or an approved fan connection issue.

Record the symptom before touching the station. Predict the normal result, list two possible causes, choose one safe test, make only the approved correction, and verify return to baseline.

::: {.callout-important title="No student-created faults"}
Never create a short, damage a connector, invent a fault, or change hardware while power is connected.
:::

Submit the prediction, hypothesis/test log, correction, and verified result.
